decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-61280517f4ea] names a concrete subject and change: the istio-cni container's `securityContext.privileged` changed from true to false, replaced by feature-specific permissions. It also says the container is still privileged under the Pod Security Standards because it keeps CAP_SYS_ADMIN. That is enough to write applicability as "environments that deploy the istio-cni component". The text does not say whether this is a chart value operators can override, or whether any admission policy setup changes who is exposed, so that narrower scoping is inferred rather than stated.
